# tasks/logs/
# Auto-generated session logs. Gitignored — local only.
# Created by hooks/post-run.sh after every Claude Code session.
#
# Format: session-YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS.md
#
# Each log contains:
# - Files modified/added/deleted (git diff)
# - Git branch + last commit
# - Node version + working directory
# - Space for Claude's lesson entry (filled via /lesson command)
#
# These are for your reference only — not committed to the repo.
# Add tasks/logs/ to your .gitignore.
